title: Julien Desclodure
text:
Professional, academic or examination backgrounds















Sep 2026 - present


Statistical Confidentiality Methodology Officer at Insee – French National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies.





Sep 2023 - Aug 2026


Data scientist at DGCL – French General Directorate for Local Authorities.





Sep 2021 - Jun 2023


Ensai as a Statistician attaché at Insee – French National School of Statistics and Analysis of Information.





Pre-2021


Teacher, master and agrégation in mathematics.
